original: 벌써 3주째인데 아직도 안 왔어요. 연락 없으면 카드사에 이의제기할게요.
english: It's been 3 weeks and it still hasn't arrived. If I don't hear back, I'll file a dispute with my card company.

original: 배송 조회가 일주일째 그대로예요. 확인 부탁드려요.
english: Tracking hasn't changed in a week. Could you check?

original: Can you ship to a different address than my billing address?
english: Can you ship to a different address than my billing address?

original: 개인통관고유부호는 어디에 입력하면 되나요?
english: Where do I enter my personal customs clearance code?

original: Sie hatten mir eine Rückerstattung versprochen. Wann kommt sie?
english: You promised me a refund. When will it come?

original: 사진이랑 색이 너무 달라요. 베이지가 아니라 회색이에요.
english: The color is very different from the photo. It's grey, not beige.

original: Package says delivered but I don't have it.
english: Package says delivered but I don't have it.

original: Mサイズの着丈は何cmですか？
english: What is the length of size M in cm?

original: My order never showed up. Can you check what happened?
english: My order never showed up. Can you check what happened?

original: Another order of mine is missing. I never got it.
english: Another order of mine is missing. I never got it.

original: Same problem again - the package is not here.
english: Same problem again - the package is not here.

original: There is no tracking number on my order. Has it shipped?
english: There is no tracking number on my order. Has it shipped?

original: Still nothing here and still no tracking. Please advise.
english: Still nothing here and still no tracking. Please advise.

original: 주문한 상품이 아직 도착하지 않았어요. 배송 상황을 알려주실 수 있을까요?
english: My order hasn't arrived yet. Could you let me know the shipping status?

original: 통관 중이라고 나오는데 며칠 더 걸릴까요?
english: It says it's in customs clearance. How many more days will it take?

original: 발송 안내를 아직 못 받았는데 언제 보내주시나요?
english: I haven't received a shipping notice yet. When will it be sent?

original: 운송장 번호를 알려주실 수 있나요?
english: Could you give me the tracking number?

original: 통관에서 멈춘 것 같아요. 필요한 서류가 있으면 알려주세요.
english: It looks like it's stuck in customs. Please let me know if any documents are needed.

original: My tracking hasn't updated for several days. Any news?
english: My tracking hasn't updated for several days. Any news?

original: I still have no shipping confirmation. When does my order go out?
english: I still have no shipping confirmation. When does my order go out?

original: M 사이즈 어깨 너비가 몇 cm인가요?
english: What is the shoulder width of size M in cm?

original: 키가 165cm인데 S와 M 중 어느 것이 좋을까요?
english: I'm 165 cm tall. Would S or M suit me better?

original: 사이즈표가 인치로만 있어서요. cm로도 알려주실 수 있나요?
english: The size chart is only in inches. Could you give me the measurements in cm as well?

original: 스웨터 소매 길이를 알려주실 수 있나요?
english: Could you tell me the sleeve length of the sweater?

original: Is the cardigan true to size, or should I size up?
english: Is the cardigan true to size, or should I size up?

original: Could you share the chest measurement for size L in cm?
english: Could you share the chest measurement for size L in cm?

original: 화면에서 보이는 색과 실제 색이 많이 다른가요?
english: Is the actual color very different from what I see on screen?

original: 오트 색상이 사진보다 더 회색빛인가요?
english: Is the oat color greyer than it looks in the photo?

original: Does the oat shade read more beige or more grey in daylight?
english: Does the oat shade read more beige or more grey in daylight?

original: 선물 포장도 해주시나요?
english: Do you offer gift wrapping as well?

original: Will you restock the cashmere coat in grey?
english: Will you restock the cashmere coat in grey?
